FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Operations Manager, Sparkle Clean Solutions, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Sparkle Clean Solutions, we provide professional janitorial and cleaning services tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients, including commercial office buildings, retail spaces, and educational institutions. Our operations focus on routine cleaning tasks such as dusting, vacuuming, floor care, and restroom sanitation, carried out during standard business hours to ensure minimal disruption. We maintain a strong commitment to employee safety, which includes documented training on the safe use of cleaning chemicals and strict adherence to written protocols for handling, storage, and disposal of all cleaning agents. Our team undergoes thorough background checks to provide a secure environment for our clients, and we focus exclusively on environmentally friendly cleaning practices to minimize our ecological footprint. All operations are supported by comprehensive management systems, and we regularly assess our processes to ensure compliance with safety regulations and client expectations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 02/15/2023; Cause: Employee accidentally damaged a client's property while cleaning; Amount: $1,500.00; Status: Resolved and paid.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Class 3 Safe, UL Listed, Fire Resistant, Commercial Grade.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with monitored security patrols during non-operational hours.
